mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm, d.department_nm, la.profile_image, CASE WHEN lg.group_code = 'LEVEL' THEN li.item_nm END AS level_nm FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id AND la.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND la.use_at = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id AND d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item li ON li.common_code_item_id = u.level_id AND li.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND li.use_at = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group lg ON lg.common_code_group_id = li.group_id AND lg.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND lg.group_code = 'LEVEL' AND lg.use_at = 'Y' WHERE u.tenant_id = #{value} AND u.use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY u.user_nm ASC, u.user_id ASC

SELECT drafting_work_category_id AS "draftingWorkCategoryId", cata_type_code AS "cataTypeCode", code_name AS "codeName", drafting_work_template_json::text AS "templateJson", drafting_work_template_html AS "templateHtml", ( drafting_work_template_json IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(drafting_work_template_html, '')), '') IS NOT NULL ) AS "hasDocument" FROM public.tb_drafting_work_category WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND drafting_work_category_id = #{workId} AND COALESCE(delete_status, 'N') <> 'Y'

SELECT employee_no FROM public.tb_drafting_work_category_authority WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND drafting_work_category_id = #{workId} AND use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(delete_status, 'N') <> 'Y' ORDER BY employee_no ASC

INSERT INTO public.tb_drafting_work_category ( tenant_id, category_item_id, cata_type_code, code_name, view_seq, reg_term, reg_term_id, reviewer_id, approver_id, use_at, delete_status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{categoryItemId}, #{divisionCode}, #{divisionName}, 0, #{cycle}, #{regTermId}, #{reviewerId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{approverId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{useAt}, 'N', #{createdBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, cata_type_code) WHERE delete_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Y' DO NOTHING RETURNING drafting_work_category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tb_drafting_work_category_authority ( tenant_id, drafting_work_category_id, cata_type_code, employee_no, use_at, delete_status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{workId}, #{cataTypeCode}, #{employeeNo}, 'Y', 'N', #{createdBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, drafting_work_category_id, employee_no) DO UPDATE SET cata_type_code = EXCLUDED.cata_type_code, use_at = 'Y', delete_status = 'N', updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_drafting_work_category SET category_item_id = #{categoryItemId}, code_name = #{codeName}, reg_term_id = #{regTermId}, reg_term = #{cycle}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, approver_id = #{approverId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND drafting_work_category_id = #{workId} AND COALESCE(delete_status, 'N') <> 'Y'

UPDATE public.tb_drafting_work_category SET drafting_work_template_json = CAST(#{templateJson} AS jsonb), drafting_work_template_html = #{templateHtml}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND drafting_work_category_id = #{workId} AND COALESCE(delete_status, 'N') <> 'Y'

UPDATE public.tb_drafting_work_category_authority SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND drafting_work_category_id = #{workId} AND use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(delete_status, 'N') <> 'Y'
